title: GeoVersa: Design-Based Residual-Correction Forests for Digital Soil Mapping
description: Design-based residual-correction forests for spatial predictive mapping. This release archives the code that produced the results reported in the accompanying manuscript on design-based assessment of prediction-interval coverage under clustered calibration. It contains no third-party data.

creators.name: Rodrigues, Hugo
creators.affiliation: University of Florida, Range Cattle Research and Education Center

notes: The DB-TARF core is published on CRAN as the GeoVersa R package (v0.3.0, 2026-07-06). The ConvKrigingNet2D deep-kriging code is research code kept in the repository and is not part of the CRAN package. Benchmark uses the Wadoux et al. (2021) design-based validation framework.
